en.quote: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return? Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
en.riddle: do men fall, and not rise up again? Doth one turn away, and not return?
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הֲיִפְּלוּ, וְלֹא יָקוּמוּ; אִם-יָשׁוּב, וְלֹא יָשׁוּב. מַדּוּעַ שׁוֹבְבָה הָעָם הַזֶּה יְרוּשָׁלִַם מְשֻׁבָה נִצַּחַת הֶחֱזִיקוּ בַּתַּרְמִית מֵאֲנוּ לָשֽׁוּב
he.riddle: הֲיִפְּלוּ, וְלֹא יָקוּמוּ; אִם-יָשׁוּב, וְלֹא יָשׁוּב.
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי

en.quote: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? Is not her King in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities? The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
en.riddle: Is not the LORD in Zion? Is not her King in her?
en.speaker: daughter of my people

he.quote: הִנֵּה-קוֹל שַֽׁוְעַת בַּת-עַמִּי מֵאֶרֶץ מַרְחַקִּים הַיהוָה אֵין בְּצִיּוֹן, אִם-מַלְכָּהּ אֵין בָּהּ; מַדּוּעַ הִכְעִסוּנִי בִּפְסִלֵיהֶם בְּהַבְלֵי נֵכָֽר עָבַר קָצִיר כָּלָה קָיִץ וַאֲנַחְנוּ לוֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ
he.riddle: הַיהוָה אֵין בְּצִיּוֹן, אִם-מַלְכָּהּ אֵין בָּהּ;
he.speaker: בַּת-עַמִּי
